name: Harbourview Shoppes
summary: Harbourview Shoppes is an upscale waterfront shopping center in Roslyn, New York, serving the affluent North Shore communities of Long Island. The open-air center offers quality retail and services with scenic harbor views in one of Nassau County's most prestigious locations.
demographics: Harbourview Shoppes attracts an affluent demographic from the North Shore of Long Island, particularly from Roslyn and surrounding Nassau County communities known for high household incomes and educated professionals. The primary trade area consists of upper-middle-class families and empty nesters with strong purchasing power, drawn to the waterfront location and quality retail offerings. Shoppers typically seek convenience-oriented retail and services in an upscale setting, with preferences for specialty shops and dining experiences that complement the harbor views and premium residential neighborhoods nearby.
description: Harbourview Shoppes is a distinctive waterfront shopping destination located in the affluent village of Roslyn on Long Island's North Shore. Situated at 1520 Old Northern Boulevard, this open-air retail center offers visitors a unique shopping experience with scenic harbor views that set it apart from typical suburban shopping venues. The center serves the prosperous communities of Roslyn, Roslyn Heights, and the surrounding Nassau County area, providing convenient access to quality retail and services for discerning local residents. With its prime location along the historic Northern Boulevard corridor, Harbourview Shoppes combines accessibility with an upscale atmosphere that reflects the character of one of Long Island's most desirable communities. The center maintains strong community connections and has earned a solid 4.6-star rating from visitors who appreciate its blend of convenience, quality tenants, and pleasant waterfront setting.
